insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Assisted Reproduction Treatment: 36-month waiting period; newborn coverage requires mother continuously insured for 12 months.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured (Single Private A/C Room)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes ICU, surgeon fees, diagnostics, dialysis, chemo/radio, pacemaker, stent. 'Any one illness' covers relapse within 45 days as same hospitalization.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day-care procedures covered up to Sum Insured

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Excludes asthma, bronchitis, hypertension, diabetes, epilepsy, influenza, psychiatric disorders, arthritis and similar listed conditions.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: In-patient AYUSH treatment up to Sum Insured
ayush_coverage.notes: Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy. Yoga/Naturopathy requires prior approval.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: 10% of SI or Rs 50,000 whichever is less; from 16th day to policy expiry
newborn_coverage.notes: Mother must be continuously insured for 12 months without break.

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: 10% of SI or Rs 1 lakh whichever is less
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor in-patient hospitalization for organ transplant; transplantation claim must be payable.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance Rs 750/hosp, Rs 1500/policy. Air ambulance: 10% of SI per year for SI >= Rs 5L.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Automatic Restoration 3 times at 100% each (SI >= Rs 3L). Plus Recharge Benefit (once per policy period).
restoration_benefit.notes: Restored SI usable only for unrelated illness. Recharge benefit usable for same hospitalization. Not for Modern Treatment.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Network-arranged check-up; Package A (SI Rs 5-10L) / Package B (SI Rs 15L+)

copayment_trigger_notes: Mandatory 20% co-payment for entry age 61 years and above (fresh and renewal). Voluntary co-payment options 10%/20% with premium discount.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Rs 40,000-50,000 per eye; Rs 60,000-75,000 per policy period (varies by SI)

notable_exclusions_summary: Cosmetic, gender change, substance abuse, self-injury, unproven treatments and non-medically-necessary admissions are not covered. Sub-fertility treatment excludes pre/post treatment, surrogacy services, cryopreservation, selective termination, fertility-enhancing surgeries.
claim_process_summary: Cashless at 14,000+ network hospitals; 97% claims approved in under 3 hours. Helpline 044-6900 6900.
